result: Merge and both fixes are correct; no blockers. The built-in review is unusable, so this is my own review.

The built-in `/code-review d7c4925...HEAD` ran in the main checkout, where HEAD is 953b4d5. It found the range empty and reviewed other code. I did not adopt its findings. Its first finding, about session-link debris, is the case `b5af9dd` addresses. The other five concern `d7c4925` code outside this range.

- `bunx --no-install mise run build` -> exit 0. `git status --short` stayed empty, so the bundle matches a fresh build.

notes (optional, each probed with `cleanMessage`):
- `packages/runtime/src/vcs/message.ts:35`: a link whose URL contains parentheses leaves a stray `)`. `[S](https://claude.ai/code/abc?x=(1))` becomes `)`. The URL pattern stops at `)`, and the old code behaved the same.
- Same file: a nested image link `[![i](u)](https://claude.ai/..)` leaves `[![i](u)]()`. The link text excludes brackets, so it cannot match.
- Same file: `[a\nb](url)` split across lines keeps `[a`, `b]()`. This is by design of line-wise cleaning.
- The updated test expects `See  for details` with a double space. It is stable behavior, but cosmetic.
